sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A Sovereign Agentic Website is delivered with six or seven agents already set up and coordinated in its repository.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: A website with a team inside: seven roles, one conductor to talk to, a policy each, nothing live without a yes.

sections.label: Not a site, a team
sections.line: The owner gets not only the site but the team that made it, set up and coordinated in the repository.

sections.label: The seven roles
sections.line: Conductor, designer, writer, developer, reviewer, translator and keeper, each written down.

sections.label: One request, through the team
sections.line: A florist's Mother's Day page, from her words to live, with one preview and one yes.

sections.label: How they are coordinated
sections.line: All files in the owner's repository: a CLAUDE.md, a brief and a policy per role, signed commits, checks.

sections.label: Why it matters
sections.line: It removes the looking after, the team moves with the site, and each site is a behaviour policy at work.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Today's sites carry one agent's policy; the seven-role team is the next step; the florist is illustrative.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Designing sovereignwebsite.ai, the website cell, the team's operating system and the policy pieces.
